scope_rule: This officer representation standard is force-wide for Sword Manor. It does not depend on assignment to Tang Wei.
persistent_unit_command_rule: Every persistent Sword Manor unit commander and formal unit deputy uses full-character representation and remains separately conserved command establishment above that unit's fighting strength.
internal_representation_rule: All 1,000/500 Sword Manor commanders are persistent person-lite officers with real stats and development state while remaining conserved fighting-establishment bodies. 100-man command remains aggregate unless independently salient.
training_delegation_rule: Sword Manor internal military training may delegate role-aware adaptive development to its aggregate ranks and represented officer chain without requiring Tang Wei to choose individual focuses. Training still consumes only lawfully earned institutional training time.
internal_loadout_rule: all current Sword Manor ranks are non-cavalry, so their 1,000/500 commanders use House Guard loadout; future cavalry officer billets use House Champion loadout.
